summary.name: Juno
summary.one_liner: Juno is an AI qualitative research tool that designs a study, interviews real people, and reports the findings with linked evidence and quotes.
use_cases: Running customer interviews without a research platform
Testing concepts, ads or product pages with real people
Investigating why customers churn or disagree
Gathering qualitative evidence for policy or business decisions
Giving AI agents a way to ask real people questions
summary.what_it_does:
Juno takes a research brief, designs the study, and works out who to interview and what to test. It runs interviews with real people, including follow-up probing, and can show images, video, concepts or prototypes during interviews. It also supports up to six quantitative questions within each interview. Afterward it reports answers with quotes, transcripts, segments and raw data, and links each claim to supporting evidence. It can be used directly by teams, embedded in a product, or accessed by agents through APIs.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">paid
notable: Recruits from a global panel of 21 million people or uses your own participants
Every insight links back to transcripts and interview moments
Enterprise controls including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, SSO and PII redaction
caveats: Pay per completed interview at $45 USD, not inclusive of recruitment or incentives; custom rates available for complex or regular research
Panel availability varies by market and target profile
Interviews are brand-blinded by default, so the commissioning client is not disclosed unless included in the study design
